title: Destiny matrix: Natalia Ladini’s method and how it is calculated

seo.title: Destiny Matrix: the Ladini Method — How It Is Calculated
seo.description: Who the author is, how a birth date becomes a chart of 22 arcana, how the points are read, and where the method’s limits lie.

how to calculate the destiny matrix ladini
how does the destiny matrix work

short: The destiny matrix is an esoteric system created by Natalia Ladini: it breaks a person’s birth date down into 22 major arcana and places them at the points of a chart. There is no mystery in the calculation itself — it is arithmetic plus a single dictionary of meanings applied to every position in the same way. This page explains who created the method, how a date turns into a chart, how a reading on this site is put together and, above all, where the method’s limits are — so that you know what it helps with and what it does not.

paragraphs: The method was created by Natalia Ladini; her own full name for it is “Reading Your Purpose. The Destiny Matrix”. The Ladini school calls her the original source of the method and the author of the formula for the 22 paths, and says the method is more than fifteen years old. Most people know it from the book “The Destiny Matrix. The Original Source” — which is where the familiar phrase “destiny matrix by Ladini” comes from.

Arcana Sense calculates by the same method: the same reducing of the digits of the date, the same octagram built from the personal and the family squares, the same names for the points. Only the texts are different — they were written for this site and do not reproduce the book. The site is not connected with Natalia Ladini’s school and does not represent her training programmes.

sections.h2: What the system is built from
paragraphs: At the base of the destiny matrix are the 22 major arcana — the same images as in a classic Tarot deck, but here they do not work as fortune telling with cards. They work as a set of 22 basic characters, or energies. Each arcanum describes a recognisable type: will and beginnings, depth and solitude, passion and dependence, order and support, and so on. The whole reading is built out of these 22 meanings and their combinations, and out of nothing else.

The system is esoteric, not scientific: there is no body of evidence behind it, the way there is behind psychology or the exact sciences. It is a language of self-observation — a way to describe your strong and weak sides through images you can grasp. The honest way to treat it is as a tool for reflection, not as a verdict or a prophecy.

sections.h2: How a birth date becomes a chart
paragraphs: The date enters the chart in four big steps. The day becomes personality portrait A, the month becomes spiritual task B, the digits of the year become material task C, and their sum gives root task D. If a number comes out larger than 22, it is not cut off and not divided with a remainder: the digits are added together. So 31 turns into 4, 44 turns into 8, and a 22 that stands on its own stays 22. Then A, B, C and D meet in centre E — the state from which the inner points are built.

From there the chart looks less like a bag of numbers and more like a map of roads. Talent runs along B–P–K, money along L–R2–R, relationships along M–R1–R, and the karmic tail along M–N–D. The same nine at the entrance to relationships and at the root task will sound different, because it answers different questions and leads on to different points. Position is what turns an arcanum into an interpretation; shuffling the numbers to get a name you like is like swapping the beginning and the ending of a story.

sections.h2: How a reading on this site works
paragraphs: Each page of the encyclopedia describes one element of the system: a single arcanum in all of its positions, a particular point of the chart, a combination of two arcana, or a karmic tail made of three. The texts are not stitched together from different sources and not rewritten from competitors — they are built from one dictionary of arcana meanings, applied in the same way to every position.

This gives consistency: arcanum 15 on its own page, in a position and inside a tail of three is described without contradictions, because all of them lean on the same core meaning. The chart reading that the calculator produces follows the same rules — it is not invented afresh every time, it is put together from the same bricks as the reference pages.

The destiny matrix describes leanings and typical scenarios, not events with dates on them. It does not predict a wedding, a move or an income by a particular deadline, and it does not replace professional advice about your body, your mind or your money. All the chart does is point out where a person has support and where they stumble more often.

Use it in that spirit: as a reason to stop and look at yourself from the outside, not as a verdict or a set of instructions for life. No arcanum is “bad” or “good” — each one has a strong version and a weak version, and which of them shows up is decided by the person, not by the chart.

faq.a: Natalia Ladini created the method and described it in the book “The Destiny Matrix. The Original Source”. The calculation on this site follows her scheme: the digits of the date are reduced to 22 arcana and spread across the points of the chart.

faq.q: Is this the same method as Natalia Ladini’s?
faq.a: Yes, the calculation follows the same method: the same 22 arcana, the same reducing of the digits of the date and the same points of the chart. The texts of the reading are our own — they are built from one dictionary of arcana meanings, not copied out of the book.

faq.q: Is the destiny matrix a science?
faq.a: No. It is an esoteric system based on 22 arcana, and there is no scientific evidence behind it. The honest way to take it is as a language of self-observation and a reason to think, not as exact knowledge about a person or about the future.

faq.q: Do you need an exact birth date?
faq.a: Yes — the day, the month and the year of birth are the only input the calculation uses. The destiny matrix does not need the time or the place of birth, unlike an astrological natal chart.

faq.q: How is this different from fortune telling with Tarot cards?
faq.a: The images of the arcana are the same, but the principle is different. In fortune telling the cards fall at random and are read against a question; here the set of arcana is fixed by the birth date and never changes — it is a fixed map of character, not a spread about one situation.

faq.q: Can you trust a forecast made from the matrix?
faq.a: The matrix describes leanings, not events, so “will it happen or not” is the wrong question to ask it. It is more useful to look at whether you recognise yourself in the description of your strong and weak sides: that, and not prediction, is what it gives.
